episodic.content: As of 2026-10-20, Mira remained the person responsible for the ORBIT-NIGHTLY project.

procedural.content: For ORBIT-NIGHTLY, keep the preproduction environment on delivery mode POLL-71 until audit AUDIT-62 passes. Only after the audit passes may delivery mode STREAM-93 be approved for preproduction. Do not release to any production environment; no production release is authorized.
